title: Contributing to paqueteprueba
text: Fork package clone onto computer. haven’t done , recommend using usethis::create_from_github("ManuelaBulgubure/paqueteprueba", fork = TRUE). Install development dependencies pak::local_install_dev_deps(), make sure package passes R CMD check running devtools::check(). R CMD check doesn’t pass cleanly, ’s good idea ask help continuing. Create Git branch pull request (PR). recommend using usethis::pr_init("brief-description--change"). Make changes check package passes R CMD check running devtools::check() . Commit changes git, create PR running usethis::pr_push(), follow prompts browser. title PR briefly describe change. body PR contain Fixes #issue-number. user-facing changes, add bullet top NEWS.md (.e. just first header). Follow style described https://style.tidyverse.org/news.html.
